title: DRAFT CW-AIP v2 SpecialistHandoff payload (not enforced)
description: Draft only. No validator applies this schema and a v2 SpecialistHandoff envelope is still rejected; keep emitting SpecialistHandoff as v1 until this draft is promoted. Fields may change without notice.

skill.description: Registry id of the specialist skill being delegated to

stop_rule.description: Condition at which the specialist stops and returns, e.g. first blocker

return_contract.description: Envelope kind the specialist must return, e.g. FindingEnvelope

inputs.description: IDs of envelopes the specialist should read
